$comment: White-label configuration for traccar-web. Copy to branding.json and fill in your values. See README.md.

assets.$comment: Paths are relative to the branding/ directory. All optional; missing files are skipped with a warning.

links.$comment: Applied at runtime via the Traccar Server API (see --seed). Empty string = leave unchanged.

maps.$comment: Empty string keeps Traccar's built-in fallback key (not recommended for production) or relies on the server attribute. Set your own keys for production.
